Class MiscMathsFunctions

java.lang.Object
solvers.utilities.MiscMathsFunctions
public class MiscMathsFunctions extends Object
This class implements several basic math functions, low-level fast memory copies, matrix type changes, memory usage calculations and printing operations. Its methods are used throughout the program, therefore it was best to gather them all here.
Author:
Michail Makaronidis, 2010
